description: This file implements the AidlComposerHal class for Android's SurfaceFlinger, providing functions to manage displays, layers, and graphics configurations via AIDL interface, including callbacks, display creation/destruction, configuration, and metadata handling.

classes.name: AidlIComposerCallbackWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper class implementing the BnComposerCallback interface to forward callback events to a HWC2::ComposerCallback reference.
